# netcup_server_firewall (Data Source)

The firewall of an interface of a netcup server (SCP REST API).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_server_firewall" "example" {
  server_id = 12345
  mac       = "00:00:5e:00:53:01"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mac` (String) MAC address of the interface.
- `server_id` (Number) Id of the server.

### Optional

- `consistency_check` (Boolean) Whether netcup checks that the rules have been applied, which sets `consistent`.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the firewall is active.
- `consistent` (Boolean) Whether the rules have been applied. Null without `consistency_check`. If false, `netcup_server_firewall_reapply` applies them again.
- `copied_policies` (Attributes List) Copied policies. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--copied_policies))
- `egress_implicit_rule` (String) `ACCEPT_ALL` or `DROP_ALL`.
- `ingress_implicit_rule` (String) `ACCEPT_ALL` or `DROP_ALL`.
- `user_policies` (Attributes List) Policies of the user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user_policies))

<a id="nestedatt--copied_policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `copied_policies`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description of the policy.
- `id` (Number) Id of the policy.
- `name` (String) Name of the policy.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Rules of the policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--copied_policies--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--copied_policies--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `copied_policies.rules`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) `ACCEPT` or `DROP`.
- `description` (String) Description of the rule.
- `destination_ports` (String) Destination ports of the rule.
- `destinations` (List of String) Destinations of the rule.
- `direction` (String) `INGRESS` or `EGRESS`.
- `number_of_effective_rules` (Number) The `numberOfEffectiveRules` value of netcup.
- `protocol` (String) `TCP`, `UDP`, `ICMP` or `ICMPv6`.
- `source_ports` (String) Source ports of the rule.
- `sources` (List of String) Sources of the rule.
